clips.title: The story
paras: Longbraid the Grim seeks vengeance in the Wetlands after Dun Modr falls. The Dark Iron assault shattered the Thandol Span and took the lives of his brother and many soldiers. Now he wants Balgaras the Foul slain, with the warlock's ear as proof.

The northern Wetlands are scarred by fighting between Ironforge Mountaineers and Dark Iron infiltrators. Dun Modr fell during the siege, and the western bridge of the Thandol Span was shattered. Longbraid the Grim lost many loyal soldiers and his brother in the assault. He wants the Dark Iron clan to pay for those deaths.

Scouts such as Roggo have found that Balgaras the Foul commands the Dark Iron force occupying Dun Modr. The warlock hides while ordering his soldiers to carry out his dark designs. Longbraid hopes Balgaras's death will break the force's resolve and let Ironforge's survivors secure the passage north.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Many of my soldiers died in the battle of Dun Modr. My own brother perished when the West Bridge over the Thandol Span was destroyed. Aye, the Dark Iron dwarves are a devilish breed. From what Roggo was able to gather, the leader of this band of thugs in the Wetlands is a warlock named Balgaras the Foul. He is quite a coward however. He sends his soldiers to do his bidding but stays elusive, avoiding danger.
If you can find the spineless scum, slay him and bring me his ear. I will reward you, adventurer.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Were you able to locate Balgaras the Foul yet, adventurer? He has been evading us for quite some time.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Balgaras the Foul is finally dead. While his death will not bring back the many innocent dwarves who died needlessly by his hand, it will help to restore peace of mind to those who survived. With Balgaras dead, the remaining Dark Iron scum should be easy enough to manage. Now, we must wipe them out before a new leader is sent to these parts.
